## Ctx.userLastName property

The user's last name from the Telegram profile.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get userLastName(): string;
```

## Remarks

May be `undefined` if the user has not set a last name.

## Example


```typescript
async callback() {
  console.log(this.userLastName) // "Putri"
}
```
